name: events
_comment_purpose: One row per action on a request, appended by the tool that made it in the same run: submit_request (`submitted`, `resubmitted`, actor the requester), review_request (`reviewed`, actor `agent`, with the clamped `recommendation`), decide_request (`granted`, `denied`, `returned`, actor `approver`, with the operator's `note`), and the seed and reset (`seeded`, `reset`, actor `system`; `reset` has no request). `revision` is the request revision the event belongs to. The chat agent reads this store to answer history questions; the UI renders it as the History tab and the request timeline. Rows are never edited.
